high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account "@TAdventuro..." with a verified checkmark, indicating it is from a user named "The Adventurous Soul." The tweet was posted 2 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The content of the tweet reads: "5. Meteor lights up the sky of Kagoshima, Japan, on August 19, 2025." The image itself shows a night sky over what appears to be a rural or suburban area. The sky is dark, with some clouds scattered across it. A bright light streak is visible in the sky, resembling a meteor
